Description.Name: Steiner
Description.Details: Walter von Schan denies any connection to the House of Steiner. He is however a decorated former officer of the AFFC, graduate of the Nagelring and has a striking resemblance to a former unpopular Archon. Little is known of his youth but he grew up on Furillo before moving to Tharkad to attend The Nagelring. On graduating he piloted a ZEU-6S. Walter's repeated denials lead to his callsign "Steiner". He frequently complains about how slow his mechs are, sometimes wishing the commonwealth would make a good LAM. COMMUNITY CONTENT
